text: livermore: 'RANGE while peers broke; DECELERATING; no new high.' Agreed no pivot cleared, so I do not call CHD a breakout. My read is a C2 retracement: a pullback inside a strong swing turning up on day_vol 1.85. Buying inside the swing is what a retracement is, not a defect. Resistance warn overhead caps me at 2. I drop support if RANGE resolves down through the swing low, or the hourly trigger above Friday's high does not come within 2 sessions (C18).
